verdict.rationale: Hardware media encode/decode is a fair axis for a laptop SoC, but the evidence pack never mentions a video engine or any AV1, HEVC, or ProRes-class codec support. It covers only CPU cores, NPU TOPS, memory bandwidth, availability, and AI tooling.

support.subject: As a creator, hardware media engines carry my editing and streaming — documented hardware encode and decode (AV1, HEVC, ProRes-class) on the chip itself
